paragraphs: Manyomi the Elder of Gush Chalav. Mentioned at the beginning of the Song of Songs section of Zohar Chadash.[^1][^2]

notes.text: שה״ש is expanded as Song of Songs, and ריש as “beginning,” within Zohar Chadash. No specific edition or finer numbering is independently verified.
סבא means the Elder; דגוש חלב means “of Gush Chalav,” with ד as a prefix rather than part of Degosh. The notice supplies no additional personal title or identity.
